title: Efficacy and Tolerability Study of ZP-025 Vaginal Gel for the Treatment of Vaginal Dryness
brief_summary: Evaluation of ZP-025 vaginal gel in terms of efficacy and safety in the treatment of vaginal dryness in post-menopausal women with vaginal atrophy in comparison to a group of non-treated post-menopausal women with vaginal atrophy after 56 consecutive days and at 4-week follow-up only for women applying ZP-025 vaginal gel.
